Documented shortcuts (docs/SEARCH_LIMITATIONS.md)

Tier-C target-seating sub-substrate — deterministic no-agent push-time target seat for SAFE targeted triggered abilities (lever-a: Sunset Saboteur + Exosuit Savior + Baseball Bat)**Equipment-AA family extension (2026-05-31, `feature/equipment-aa-substrate`).** A THIRD consumer rides this shared seat: **Baseball Bat** (`{3}` Artifact — Equipment), via the FIRST `ATTACKS` + `IsHost(subject="attacker")` targeted-safe trigger (`TapUpToOneTargetCreature`, `count_min=0` — the same optional edge as Exosuit Savior). The seat arm (`first_legal_trigger_target`'s `Effect::TapUpToOneTargetCreature` match) scans `bf_iter_etb_sorted` for the FIRST creature on EITHER battlefield (bare `IsCreature()` filter — NO controller restriction, NO source exclusion); the resolve arm taps the seated target via `tap_permanent_and_dispatch` with a CR 608.2b re-legality check (no seat ⇒ no-op, the optional declined). The Equipment fires the trigger from its `attached_to` host: the `Predicate::IsHost` match (`cards.rs:10770`, NOT Aura-restricted — reads `find_object_attached_to(source)`) and the `is_host_attacker` sentinel collapse in `_is_safe_trigger_dict` are the load-bearing shared Equipment-attached-carrier bridge. The probe stamps `attached_to` via the PyO3 `attach(equip_id, host_id)` method (the ETB auto-attach `AttachToTargetCreatureYouControl` is a separately-covered Effect; the probe exercises the ATTACKS rider in isolation per the established per-card-module convention). Pinned by `tests/test_baseball_bat_parity.py`. NO new seat machinery — pure reuse of the Sunset Saboteur / Exosuit Savior shared seat; the only genuinely-new Rust Effect is `TapUpToOneTargetCreature`.
Tier-C target-seating sub-substrate — original entry (lever-a: Sunset Saboteur + Exosuit Savior)**Location**: `rust/src/state_ops_resolve.rs` (`first_legal_trigger_target` next to `push_triggered_ability` — the gated push-time first-legal seat into the EXISTING `TriggerPayload.target_id` via `new_trigger_with_target`; the `Effect::PutPlusOneCounterOnOpponentsCreature` and `Effect::ReturnTargetPermanentYouControlToOwnersHand` resolve arms reading `current_resolve_payload_target_id` with a CR 608.2b re-legality check; `lever_trigger_requires_target` distinguishes the `count_min>=1` skip-push-fizzle (Sunset Saboteur) from the `count_min==0` push-with-no-target no-op (Exosuit Savior)) + `src/mtg_bot/actions.py` (`_put_triggered_ability_on_stack` — the `controller.agent is None` branch's gated `pool[0]` seat) + `src/mtg_bot/parity/trajectory.py` (`_is_target_seated_safe_trigger` — the surgical gate).
Tier-C target-seating sub-substrate — original entry (lever-a: Sunset Saboteur + Exosuit Savior)**What the shortcut is**: real MTG picks a triggered ability's target when it is put on the stack (CR 603.3d) by the ability's controller's *choice*. The substrate replaces that choice with a deterministic first-legal pick (no agent): the smallest-bf-index object that passes the slot filter, scanning `state.players` in ascending seat index then each player's `battlefield` Vec in insertion order (Python's `Effect._enumerate_for_filter` order; the `_PickFirstLegalTargetAgent` shim's pick). For Sunset Saboteur (`ATTACKS / IsSelf / PutPlusOneCounterOnOpponentsCreature`, `count_min=1`) that is the first creature an opponent of the source's controller controls; no eligible target ⇒ the trigger fizzles (CR 603.3c — not pushed) byte-equal on both engines. For Exosuit Savior (`ENTERS / IsSelf / ReturnTargetPermanentYouControlToOwnersHand`, `count_min=0` — the optional-bounce edge) that is the first non-source permanent the source's controller controls; no eligible permanent ⇒ the trigger is pushed with NO target and the optional resolves as a no-op (byte-equal with Python's `targets=()` `Bounce.resolve` early-return — the optional is *declined*, NOT fizzled, the distinct `count_min==0` semantics). The seat is **gated** (`_is_target_seated_safe_trigger` / `first_legal_trigger_target`'s per-variant match) so it fires ONLY for the lever-admitted targeted safe triggers — every existing untargeted safe trigger and every non-lever targeted trigger keeps its prior behavior byte-identically.
Tier-C target-seating sub-substrate — original entry (lever-a: Sunset Saboteur + Exosuit Savior)**Impact estimate**: parity-positive, zero strength claim. Flips **both** Tier-C target-seating consumers from Effect-uncovered / bench-dropped to byte-equal bench-admittable: Sunset Saboteur (6,375 17lands decks, the `count_min=1` mandatory-counter card) + Exosuit Savior (12,480 decks, the `count_min=0` optional-bounce edge) = **2 cards / 18,855 17lands decks** — the complete honest Tier-C target-seating payoff (NOT ~39k: Terrapact / Genemorph / Boilerbilges each carry a SECOND blocking substrate and are honest exclusions, per the design's §5.3/§6 honest-shrinkage). No further target-seating consumers remain.

Documented shortcuts (docs/SEARCH_LIMITATIONS.md)

Improvise, Saddle and clones**What the shortcut is.** Improvise is checked like convoke (upper-bound affordability), and the engine -- not the agent -- picks which artifacts to tap: artifacts without mana abilities first, as many as the generic cost needs, before any land is tapped. Keeping an artifact untapped instead of a land is therefore not a searchable choice. Saddle picks riders one at a time through `choose_permanent_to_tap` (plain power; crew-only bonuses don't apply). Phyrexian Metamorph / Superior Spider-Man copy the target's printing (its copiable values); Superior Spider-Man's "When you do, exile that card." is a trigger put on the stack right after it enters.

Documented shortcuts (docs/SEARCH_LIMITATIONS.md)

Rust-parity-pinned lossy legacy spells**What the shortcut is.** The compositional phrase grammar models "target creature or planeswalker", "counter target spell unless its controller pays {N}", and other surfaces faithfully, but five Edge-of-Eternities-era spells were claimed earlier through lossy legacy recognizers (planeswalker target arm dropped, pay-or-counter tax dropped, riders dropped, or only one of several modes kept) and their simplified models are pinned by cross-engine parity tests against the Rust engine: Divert Disaster, Don't Make a Sound, Archenemy's Charm, Scorching Dragonfire, Break Down the Door (plus Get Out / Untimely Malfunction for the single-parseable-mode modal fallback). While one of those names is being parsed the compositional grammar is switched off, so they keep the legacy models. Every other card with the same printed surfaces (including the cube's Mana Leak, Sear, Baleful Mastery, Unholy Heat, Mine Collapse, …) now parses faithfully, and the single-parseable-mode fallback no longer claims non-legacy modal spells (Suplex, Sheoldred's Edict must parse every mode).
"Dies this turn -> exile instead" rider is a per-object flag**Where:** `src/mtg_bot/game.py::GameObject.exile_if_dies_this_turn`, set by `effects/generic/spell_damage.py::DealDamageExileIfDiesThisTurn` (Suplex), consumed by `turn.move_off_battlefield`, cleared at cleanup.

PowerLSV cube W/G creature bucket — deliberate simplifications (2026-09-27, `feature/cube-creatures-wg`)21. **Targeted spells and "becomes the target"** (Surrak, Elusive Hunter): `cube_creatures_rmc.fire_becomes_target` now also dispatches `BECOMES_TARGET` for a spell targeted on the stack, with the spell as the `target_spell` subject (not `target`), so the existing "a permanent you control becomes the target" observers never see spells. PowerLSV cube "glue" bucket — deliberate simplifications (2026-09-27, `feature/cube-glue`)The last sixteen normal-layout cube cards (Chandra, Torch of Defiance; Oko, Thief of Crowns; Wrenn and Six; Ugin, Eye of the Storms; Kaito, Bane of Nightmares; Nissa, Who Shakes the World; Tamiyo, Collector of Tales; Comet, Stellar Pup; Shelldock Isle; Coalition Relic; Mana Drain; Fear of Missing Out; Mawloc; Cloak and Dagger, Entwined; Tidehollow Sculler; Gleemox). Engine code: `src/mtg_bot/effects/generic/cube_glue.py`, `src/mtg_bot/player_protections.py`, `src/mtg_bot/cube_glue_statics.py`, hooks in `turn.py` / `simulate.py` / `search/engine_adapter.py` (step hooks only) / `actions.py` / `legal.py` / `game.py`; grammar: `src/mtg_bot/cards/parser/cube_glue_grammar.py` (last `_parse_effect` fallback, switched off for EoE-only printings through the shared `creature_rmc_grammar` guard). Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Fear of Missing Out are also Duskmourn printings, so -- like Enduring Innocence in the W/G bucket -- they become claimed in the `eoe` / `all` pools too; no other EoE printing's parse changes.

Cube planeswalker bucket — engine shortcuts behind the claimed walkers (2026-09-27, `feature/cube-planeswalkers`)Claimed walkers: The Wandering Emperor, Elspeth Storm Slayer, Jace Wielder of Mysteries, Narset Parter of Veils, Teferi Time Raveler, Minsc & Boo, Saheeli Sublime Artificer, Jace the Mind Sculptor, Teferi Hero of Dominaria, Dack Fayden, Karn Scion of Urza (plus Tezzeret, Cruel Captain, unchanged). Each shortcut below is deliberate; none drops a printed clause.
Cube planeswalker bucket — engine shortcuts behind the claimed walkers (2026-09-27, `feature/cube-planeswalkers`)**3. "At the beginning of the next end step" rides the controller's own end step.** *Where:* `cube_walkers.py::AtBeginningOfNextEndStep` on `state.delayed_triggers` (`turn.run_delayed_end_step_triggers` fires entries on the scheduling controller's turn). Correct for every producer in the pool (Teferi, Hero of Dominaria's +1 is sorcery-speed, so the next end step is this turn's). An instant-speed producer during an opponent's turn would fire at its controller's next end step instead of the opponent's. The recognizer only claims untargeted delayed effects (a delayed trigger's targets would be chosen when it triggers). *Fix scope:* key queue entries on the upcoming end step instead of the controller's turn, ~half a cycle.
Cube planeswalker bucket — engine shortcuts behind the claimed walkers (2026-09-27, `feature/cube-planeswalkers`)**8. Indefinite control changes set `controller_id` directly; the tuck bypasses `move_off_battlefield`.** *Where:* `cube_walkers.py::GainControlOfTargetPermanently` / `GainControlOfTriggeringSpellTargets` (Dack Fayden) follow `GainControlOfTargetSliverPermanently`'s precedent (no layer-2 registry entry; a later UEOT steal's cleanup revert can snap control back to its captured baseline). `PutTargetIntoOwnersLibraryNthFromTop` (Teferi, Hero of Dominaria's -3) leaves the battlefield the way `_bounce_to_hand` does — no leaves-the-battlefield triggers fire for the tucked permanent. *Fix scope:* route both through the registry / `move_off_battlefield` with a library destination, ~half a cycle.

Documented shortcuts (docs/SEARCH_LIMITATIONS.md)

PowerLSV cube artifact bucket — deliberate simplifications (2026-09-27, `feature/cube-artifacts`)7. **"If you cast it" (The One Ring's protection)** rides the existing `ConditionalIfCastFromHand`, which always runs its inner effect (its docstring's documented degradation, pinned by the Weftwalking Rust parity test). A One Ring put onto the battlefield without being cast would wrongly grant protection.
PowerLSV cube artifact bucket — deliberate simplifications (2026-09-27, `feature/cube-artifacts`)8. **Player protection from everything (The One Ring)** prevents damage (every player-damage site, honoring can't-be-prevented combat damage) and removes the player from every target-selection site (`game.drop_protected_players`). Resolution-time target re-checks don't re-test it (a target chosen before the protection began still resolves). The engine has no player-attached permanents, so the "can't be enchanted" half is vacuous.

PowerLSV cube "glue" bucket — deliberate simplifications (2026-09-27, `feature/cube-glue`)The last sixteen normal-layout cube cards (Chandra, Torch of Defiance; Oko, Thief of Crowns; Wrenn and Six; Ugin, Eye of the Storms; Kaito, Bane of Nightmares; Nissa, Who Shakes the World; Tamiyo, Collector of Tales; Comet, Stellar Pup; Shelldock Isle; Coalition Relic; Mana Drain; Fear of Missing Out; Mawloc; Cloak and Dagger, Entwined; Tidehollow Sculler; Gleemox). Engine code: `src/mtg_bot/effects/generic/cube_glue.py`, `src/mtg_bot/player_protections.py`, `src/mtg_bot/cube_glue_statics.py`, hooks in `turn.py` / `simulate.py` / `search/engine_adapter.py` (step hooks only) / `actions.py` / `legal.py` / `game.py`; grammar: `src/mtg_bot/cards/parser/cube_glue_grammar.py` (last `_parse_effect` fallback, switched off for EoE-only printings through the shared `creature_rmc_grammar` guard). Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Fear of Missing Out are also Duskmourn printings, so -- like Enduring Innocence in the W/G bucket -- they become claimed in the `eoe` / `all` pools too; no other EoE printing's parse changes.
Other resolution-time choicesUgin's -11 and Nissa's -8 "any number" searches pick one card at a time through `choose_card_from_library` until the agent returns `None` (random / default agents take everything); Tamiyo's +1 names one of the distinct nonland names in your library or a "not in your library" option (the Demonic Consultation convention); Comet's "return a card with mana value 2 or less" (untargeted) uses the same id picker. Chandra's +1 casts through `cast_now` (the spell goes above the ability; if it's a land, uncastable, or declined, 2 damage to each opponent) and an uncast card stays in exile with no permission. Tidehollow Sculler follows the printed two-trigger text: if it leaves before its ETB resolves, the card is exiled forever.

Documented shortcuts (docs/SEARCH_LIMITATIONS.md)

Cube lands (line-composed land grammar): automatic mana payment, hand abilities, life-costed taps — 2026-09-27, `feature/cube-lands`1. **Automatic payment only uses a land's `produces` set.** Lands built by the line-composed grammar set `mana_only_from_produces=True`: a land contributes to `can_pay_cost` / `auto_tap_for_cost` only through its free (or life-costed) `{T}: Add` production. Mana abilities with any other cost or shape — Gaea's Cradle / Tolarian Academy (scaling), Mishra's Workshop (spend restriction), Sunken Ruins (filter, `{U/B}` input), Gemstone Mine (counter cost), Starting Town's `{T}, Pay 1 life: Add one mana of any color`, Arena of Glory's exert ability — are explicit mana abilities, usable only by activating them (which `legal_actions` offers only in a sorcery window, like every activated ability) and floating the mana. So none of them can pay for an instant-speed cast.

Transform bookkeeping (CR 701.28f) and copies of DFCs**What the shortcut is.** "Transform CARDNAME" from an activated / triggered ability resolves even if the permanent already transformed after the ability was put on the stack (CR 701.28f says it then does nothing): activating Ulvenwald Oddity's ability twice in response to itself flips it back. A token copy of a DFC copies the face that's up and never transforms (correct), but a non-token copy effect (`original_printing`) of a transformed permanent isn't specially handled.

Documented shortcuts (docs/SEARCH_LIMITATIONS.md)

Rust-parity-pinned lossy legacy spells**What the shortcut is.** The compositional phrase grammar models "target creature or planeswalker", "counter target spell unless its controller pays {N}", and other surfaces faithfully, but five Edge-of-Eternities-era spells were claimed earlier through lossy legacy recognizers (planeswalker target arm dropped, pay-or-counter tax dropped, riders dropped, or only one of several modes kept) and their simplified models are pinned by cross-engine parity tests against the Rust engine: Divert Disaster, Don't Make a Sound, Archenemy's Charm, Scorching Dragonfire, Break Down the Door (plus Get Out / Untimely Malfunction for the single-parseable-mode modal fallback). While one of those names is being parsed the compositional grammar is switched off, so they keep the legacy models. Every other card with the same printed surfaces (including the cube's Mana Leak, Sear, Baleful Mastery, Unholy Heat, Mine Collapse, …) now parses faithfully, and the single-parseable-mode fallback no longer claims non-legacy modal spells (Suplex, Sheoldred's Edict must parse every mode).

Documented shortcuts (docs/SEARCH_LIMITATIONS.md)

PowerLSV cube W/G creature bucket — deliberate simplifications (2026-09-27, `feature/cube-creatures-wg`)4. **Two-player readings.** Questing Beast's "target planeswalker that player controls" is "target planeswalker an opponent controls"; Adeline and Mobilize tokens attack the (single) defending player, never a planeswalker; Ursine Monstrosity's random opponent and Okoye's "attacks the monarch" use the engine's one defending player.
Delirium and card-type counting (2026-09-28, `feature/cube-fixes-1`)Every "card types among cards in <zone>" count now goes through `mtg_bot.effects.card_types` (`card_types_of`, `count_card_types`, `delirium_active`): Delirium at both predicate tiers (`state_predicates.Delirium` for trigger gates, `conditions.DeliriumActive` for statics / "instead if" spell riders / activation restrictions — both carry the printed `min_card_types=4` and delegate to the one function), the Lhurgoyfs, Ursine Monstrosity, Keen-Eyed Curator, Occult Epiphany and Atraxa. What was wrong before: the delirium type set listed only the pre-2024 name "Tribal" (a Kindred card counted for nothing), each goyf / Ursine / Curator / Epiphany / Atraxa helper carried its own type tuple, and a card whose printing was still a back face / split half off the stack would have been read by that face. The shared helper folds Tribal into Kindred, unions a split card's halves (CR 709.4), reads a DFC by its front face (CR 712.8a — an MDFC land such as Shatterskull Smashing is a *sorcery* card in a graveyard, so it does NOT give delirium a land), reads an adventurer by its normal characteristics (CR 715.4) and skips tokens / spell copies (not cards).

PowerLSV cube W/G creature bucket — deliberate simplifications (2026-09-27, `feature/cube-creatures-wg`)7. **Cast restrictions are a `legal_actions` post-filter** (`creature_statics_wg.filter_cast_restrictions` / `filter_activation_locks` -- Voice of Victory, Archon of Emeria, Clarion Conqueror). 5 EoE pay-life shocklands admitted as plain untapped dual lands — `enters_tapped` / `pay-2-life` replacement dropped on BOTH engines (round-60 phase 1; activated-mana-ability cross-engine divergence CLOSED round-62)**What the shortcut is**: the production-deck trajectory-parity loader now admits the 5 EoE pay-life shocklands — **Breeding Pool, Watery Grave, Stomping Ground, Godless Shrine, Sacred Foundry** — as plain untapped dual-mana lands (a `CardDef(card_type="Land", mana_produced=<sorted dual>)`, the exact shape the basic-land arm emits, minus the `"Basic"` supertype gate). The real Magic card carries the replacement "As this land enters, you may pay 2 life. If you don't, it enters tapped." The live `OracleParserCardSource` **never structures that replacement at all** — it flattens each shockland to `produces={c1,c2}` + `enters_tapped=False` + zero abilities (verified round-60 against the live parser). The CardDef bridge has no `enters_tapped` field and Rust's `register_printing` has no land tapped-entry path, so the rider is dropped a SECOND time symmetrically. Net: the shockland is modeled as a vanilla untapped dual on BOTH engines — no pay-life decision, no tapped-entry, ever.
5 EoE pay-life shocklands admitted as plain untapped dual lands — `enters_tapped` / `pay-2-life` replacement dropped on BOTH engines (round-60 phase 1; activated-mana-ability cross-engine divergence CLOSED round-62)**Why it's OK**: the drop is **symmetric** — the parser flattens the printing identically before either engine sees it, so Python and Rust materialize the *same* untapped dual and round-trip **byte-equal**. Pinned at two levels: (1) static — 3 cross-engine bridge pins build the real Stomping Ground / Watery Grave / Breeding Pool CardDefs and assert `compare_fields() == []`; (2) **activated** (round-62 N1, the level round-61 N3 showed was missing) — an activated-mana-ability cross-engine pin drives `activate_ability` for EACH color index of all 5 real shocklands on BOTH engines and asserts a byte-equal pool (see the ✅ CLOSED round-62 block below); plus 1 genuine real-EoE probe drives real 17lands archetype 30 (Stomping Ground + Watery Grave) through `attack_all` divergence-free. The bench's `attack_all` strategy never makes the pay-life choice and never reads a land's tapped-state for a decision, so the *replacement* simplification is inert under the coverage it unlocks. This is the **round-39 Ward precedent** exactly (`CardDef bridge filter drops creatures with dynamic_pt_formula / ward_cost`, this doc above): a rider the bridge drops symmetrically, bit-equal under the bench play strategy, shipped blocked-at-fidelity rather than as a latent inter-engine divergence. (The activated-mana-ability path itself was a real latent divergence until round-62 fixed it — see the CLOSED block below.)
5 EoE pay-life shocklands admitted as plain untapped dual lands — `enters_tapped` / `pay-2-life` replacement dropped on BOTH engines (round-60 phase 1; activated-mana-ability cross-engine divergence CLOSED round-62)**Impact estimate**: **+5 cards / +18,065 cumulative 17lands decks** (Breeding Pool 4,712 + Watery Grave 4,226 + Stomping Ground 3,859 + Godless Shrine 2,937 + Sacred Foundry 2,331) unblocked into the production-deck bench, **0 strength cost** (no engine behavior changes; this is a bench-coverage admit, not a rules change). This is the entire *clean* realizable yield of the non-basic-land lever; the roadmap's remaining ~16,510-deck tail (the other 18) is gated behind the deferred Station / activated-ability / static / clone subsystems, not behind this substrate.

Documented shortcuts (docs/SEARCH_LIMITATIONS.md)

Printed alternative costs share the `cast_for_free` action variant**What the shortcut is.** CR 118.9 alternative costs (Force of Will, Daze, Force of Negation / Vigor, Snuff Out, Mine Collapse, Baleful Mastery, Overload on Damn / Winds of Abandon) ride the casting substrate's existing `CastSpell(cast_for_free=True)` variant — the same one `alt_casting`'s pitch costs and conditional free casts use — so there is ONE cast-time alternative-cost path and the action encoding is unchanged (the codec already has a `cast_for_free` slot). The variant means "cast for an alternative cost" rather than naming WHICH one: a free-cast permission wins, and when a card prints several payable alternatives the caster's agent picks among them with `choose_mode` inside the cast. No printed card in either pool has two payable alternatives at once, so today the variant is unambiguous. Two further approximations: (1) `search/_player_capabilities.py`'s priority short-circuit only checks mana costs, so with that heuristic enabled a player whose only castable card is a free-cast (e.g. Force of Will with no untapped lands) can be skipped; (2) when several candidates can pay an alternative cost the pick reuses existing hooks: `choose_discard` for the exiled hand card (as `alt_casting.pay_pitch_cost` does), `choose_sacrifice` for the returned / sacrificed permanent.
Overload cast needs the single-target version's target**What the shortcut is.** An Overload cast (Damn, Winds of Abandon) is only offered when the non-overloaded "target" version has a legal target, so overloading onto a board with no legal target for the single-target version isn't offered. Such a cast would do nothing, so no strategic option is lost.

3. Priority auto-pass via capability hash (opp + active player)| Edge case | Why missed | Bot misbehavior | |---|---|---| | Continuous effect grants the priority holder new instant-speed access (Vedalken Orrery, Teferi Mage of Zhalfir grants them flash) | Hash doesn't depend on continuous-effects layer beyond the count | Bot auto-passes when the priority holder could have cast a (now-flash) creature | | Cost-reduction effect lands mid-turn (Goblin Electromancer ETBs from active player's spell → opp's / active's instants get cheaper) | Hash uses raw mana_available, not effective costs | Bot auto-passes when the priority holder could afford something whose cost just got reduced | | Continuous effect grants a permanent a new activated ability (rare) | Hash captures id-set count delta, not effective set | Bot auto-passes when the priority holder could activate the granted ability | | Effect makes spells castable from a new zone (Yawgmoth's Will → graveyard cast; very rare in current pool) | Zone-castable flags watched at coarse granularity | Bot auto-passes when the priority holder could cast from graveyard | | Mana-cost change via card-type change (e.g., color-changing effect altering hybrid cost availability) | Hash uses face-value cost, not derived | Bot auto-passes if a now-castable cost wasn't recognized |
Cube spells-B: card-flow / casting-substrate shortcuts — 2026-09-27, `feature/cube-spells-b`6. **Yawgmoth's Will's graveyard-to-exile replacement** is applied precisely on the battlefield-leaving path (`move_off_battlefield` — no "dies" trigger) and the spell-leaving-the-stack path; every other entry (discard, mill, ...) is caught by a sweep at the end of `state_based_actions`, so those cards briefly exist in the graveyard (discard triggers still see a discard; the card is exiled before any player gets priority).
PowerLSV cube W/G creature bucket — deliberate simplifications (2026-09-27, `feature/cube-creatures-wg`)10. **Serra Paragon's land permission** is spent only when no unlimited land-from-graveyard permission (Icetill Explorer, Mole Man, Yawgmoth's Will) covers the play -- the player-favorable choice is made for them. Its granted rider is a per-object counter (`GameObject.leaves_to_graveyard_exile_gain_life`) fired from `move_off_battlefield`, not a layer-6 granted ability.
Dauthi Voidwalker's replacement: redirect on the main paths, SBA catch-all elsewhere**What the shortcut is.** Permanents leaving the battlefield and spells leaving the stack are exiled with a void counter before they reach the graveyard (they never "die"). Cards that reach an opponent's graveyard through other paths (discard, mill, surveil, look-at-top "into your graveyard") land there first and are swept to exile at the next state-based-action check — the same precedent as Yawgmoth's Will — so a trigger that looks at the graveyard in between can briefly see them. Cards already in the graveyard when a void source enters are snapshotted and stay.
